nodes.label: Baseline first
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Every later model must justify itself only by improvement over a trivial and a simple baseline; an XGBoost that beats chance but not logistic regression is complexity without value.

nodes.label: Data leakage
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: The enemy of the whole protocol: it produces spectacular development metrics and useless production models, which is why steps 1-3 close before any training.

nodes.label: Mandatory error analysis
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Inspecting 20-30 concrete errors for a systematic failing segment is worth more than a decimal of metric.

nodes.label: Leak-free feature construction
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Every feature must have existed with that content at prediction time; scalers, imputers and target encodings are fit inside the train fold only.

nodes.label: Single primary metric chosen by error cost
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.norm_label: single primary metric chosen by error cost
nodes.rationale: Accuracy on imbalanced classes is banned as a primary metric because it hides the error that actually costs money.

nodes.label: Split before looking at the data
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.norm_label: split before looking at the data
nodes.rationale: The test set is set aside before any analysis or feature engineering and touched once; a random split on time series is structural leakage, and repeated entities need a group split.

nodes.label: Animate only transform and opacity
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: They are the only properties the browser can animate on the compositor layer without recalculating layout or paint, so animating width/height/top/box-shadow in loops causes jank.

nodes.label: Strict refactor definition
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Structure changes, observable behaviour does not; if behaviour changes even for the better it is no longer a refactor and must be declared.

nodes.label: Characterization tests
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: When coverage is missing, first capture what the code does today — including the odd parts — without judging correctness.

nodes.label: Equivalence verification
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Same suite green with no weakened asserts, the real flow exercised as before, and the full diff re-read asking only whether any hunk changes behaviour.

nodes.label: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.norm_label: test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: The area's tests must be green before starting, so a later failure is attributable to the refactor.

nodes.label: Index write cost
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Every index speeds reads and taxes all writes to the table, so each one must be justified and redundant existing indexes retired.

nodes.label: Measure, do not guess
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: No optimization without an EXPLAIN before and a measurement after — intuition about SQL performance is wrong more often than right, and a fast query over 100 dev rows says nothing about 10M in production.

nodes.label: Application-level N+1
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: The query is fast but runs 500 times — the fix belongs in the code (JOIN/IN/dataloader), not in SQL.

nodes.label: One improvement at a time, cheapest first
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.norm_label: one improvement at a time, cheapest first
nodes.rationale: Statistics first (free), then sargable rewriting, then a new index, and structural changes only with evidence that the first three were not enough.

nodes.label: Usual plan suspects
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: Seq scan on a large table with a selective filter, an unused index due to a function or implicit cast or leading wildcard, estimates off by 100x from stale statistics, nested loop over millions of rows, sort spilling to disk.

nodes.label: Semantic equivalence check after rewriting
nodes.community_name: Test safety net before touching anything
nodes.rationale: A rewritten JOIN can duplicate rows and NULLs break NOT IN, so the same count and a checksum over a sample must still match.
